data.text: Do you create drivers for every coding agent and model in order to keep the core code common and only adjust depending on which agent and model we communicate with and probably we could even adjust to the differences mostly with confirmation than code so it will be easier to adjust to future changes and coding agents? Respectively the same for agents that ddflow instantiate as subprocesses (if we plan that in the future)? Does this make sense? Can you research it?

data.body: Operator 2026-10-23: 'Do you create drivers for every coding agent and model ... mostly with configuration than code ... same for agents that ddflow instantiates as subprocesses?' Inventory, design, options, recommendation; queues P-drivers.
data.title: Research: driver architecture (common core, per-harness and per-model drivers as data, lane transports)

data.body: Operator 2026-10-23: common core, per-agent and per-model drivers, differences mostly configuration, same for subprocess agents. Design: docs/ddflow/research/driver-architecture.md, proposals docs/ddflow/decisions/driver-architecture.md. Reuses HX-*, ATF-*, CC-inventory, TE-limit-aware-routing, CP-backend-iface, AC-*, P-agent-parity.*, CM-packs; adds only engines, the combination rule, the Lane contract, packs and the CLI.
data.title: Drivers as data: common core, harness and model registries, named engines, Lane transports, packs

data.body: Questions and defaults are in docs/ddflow/decisions/driver-architecture.md. Record each answer as a decision; mark proposals accepted or rejected.
data.title: DECIDE (lead asks the operator): driver architecture DRV-Q1..Q8 with defaults; record each answer as D-DRV-*

data.body: Turn the 110-site classification (research section 2.4: 65 data-in-code, 26 compat, 9 model-axis, 10 driver code) into a checked table; add a report-only substring counter (163 more constants today). Each moved site names the descriptor field that replaces it. No behaviour change. Test: the detector fails on a planted substring site.
data.title: Agent-name switches to a data table, enforced by the no-agent-literals ratchet (substring counter added)

data.body: Closed set E1..E8 of research section 4.2; E1-E3 are a pure move of FieldMap, the emit variants and the MCP shapes from hookio.py and mcpconfig.py, golden-tested by the existing fixtures; E4-E8 read the descriptor-v2 sections. Placeholders from a closed linted list; no shell; secrets by env name. Test: each engine against recorded fixtures (tests/fixtures/dsh_probe for stream_map) and a hostile-input case (ReDoS, huge line, bad path).
data.title: Named reusable engines (fieldmap, emit, mcp_shape, render_argv, stream_map, limit_detect, transcript_map, probe) with tests

data.body: Extend the HX-facts-core record with versions, expires, probe, by (D-DRV-3). One reader used by descriptors, the model catalog and mcpshim/clients.py rows. doctor flags an expired fact and an installed version outside the range (scheduling stays in P-agent-parity.drift); a drifted fact is demoted to unverified for dependent decisions. Test: expired, out-of-range, unknown-yields-fallback-with-reason, observation outranks document.
data.title: Fact record with version range and expiry, unknown-degrades report, drift doctor

data.body: Extends CC-inventory's family table into ddflow/models (family, model, route files); absorbs FAMILY_HINTS and review PRESETS as readers, unknown model resolves to family unknown. Fields only those ddflow reads (window, cache kind and TTL, price per token [REDACTED], long-context threshold, limits), each a fact record. Optional LiteLLM-shaped import off by default (DRV-Q6). Test: every family has source and date; unknown never matches by neighbour.
data.title: Model families, windows, prices, cache and limits as data with provenance, plus routes

data.body: effective(harness, model, route) per research 4.1: mechanism from harness, numbers from model, route override, sparse pair table, caps min, prohibitions any, observation > operator > pair > route > model > harness > LCD. Consumers: TE-limit-aware-routing, ATF launch settings, CC-advisor. Test: Claude Code on a non-Anthropic route loses explicit cache; Copilot long_context tier; unknown model gives LCD and names it.
data.title: Harness x model x route combination rule: effective capabilities with the source of each fact

data.body: The Lane contract (start, events, steer, stop, status, capabilities) and the process-headless driver built from E4+E5; ACP, Pi RPC, OpenCode HTTP and tmux plug in as transports through CP-backend-iface, AC-backend and P-agent-parity.launcher (linked, not duplicated; docs propose folding into CP-backend-iface). Cleanup by process group with a scope (Ba3b7509530, DX-runner-signal-handling, DX-ci-suite-cgroup-scope); keys by env name, lane-private home, telemetry fact from the descriptor (D-dsh-telemetry); missing capability is unavailable. Test with a fake agent replaying recorded stdout and exit codes.
data.title: Lane transport drivers: LaunchSpec, observe, steer, cleanup contract over the existing launcher and ACP work

data.body: Verbs under existing nouns (D-mcp-new-nouns). lint = loader + every-field-has-a-reader + known placeholders; test = offline conformance; probe = engine E8 only, writes a fact to the local layer; resolve prints effective capabilities with each fact's source.
data.title: ddflow harness add|lint|test|probe|facts and ddflow model show|lint|probe|resolve, no new MCP tool

data.body: Parameterised over every descriptor: schema, fixtures through E1/E5/E6/E7, argv rendering snapshot, Lane contract against the fake agent. Today fixtures exist for 5 of 23 agents: report the gap per agent (recorded true|false, version), never a pass. Reports the zero-Python-agent rate (the D-DRV-2 metric).
data.title: Offline conformance suite and fixtures per agent: engines, Lane contract, fixture gap report

data.body: Load descriptors and models from D-config-layer-order layers (harnesses.d under user, project, local); keys that run a process are operator-only; company packs are data only, pinned by digest like CM-packs (linked: CM-packs-verify). schema version per file with an upgrade-manifest migration. Records design note for option C (out-of-process JSON-stdio plugins, D-extension-seams) without building it. Test: a cloned project cannot add launch argv; a bare URL pack without digest is refused.
data.title: User, project and company descriptor and model packs with digest pinning and the operator-only split

data.body: Execute the DRV-inventory table: NORMALIZERS and EMITTERS into [hooks.fields]/[hooks.emit], compat_refs table from descriptors, approvals transcript root from a descriptor [transcripts] key; mcpshim/clients.py generated from one data file shared with the loader (shim stays stdlib-only). Lower the BASELINE with each move. Test: the ratchet, existing fixtures unchanged.
data.title: Move the remaining code switches to data: hook dialects, client names, known agent paths, transcript roots

data.body: A guide: the three axes, what is data versus code, the zero-Python recipe, writing a transport, packs and trust, probing. adding-a-harness.md is updated through its owner task to avoid overlapping P-agent-parity.descriptor-v2 globs.
data.title: Docs: how drivers work (registries, engines, Lane, facts, packs); adding-a-harness updated

data.summary: adding-a-harness.md says every descriptor value is overridable by a project, but harnessreg.load reads only the shipped ddflow/harnesses directory (HARNESS_DIR) and no caller passes another; a user or company cannot add or override an agent. Regression test: a descriptor in a project harnesses.d dir (or its override) changes harness show.

tests/test_no_agent_literals.py matches only string constants EQUAL to a descriptor id or under a descriptor directory: 110 sites, but an AST pass finds 163 more constants that contain an agent or model name (review.py presets 48, 'run prompt --harness claude' in claudehooks.py) so the ratchet understates leaks. Regression test: a planted substring site is reported by the counter.
